overall_summary: Analysis of the deduplicated performance metrics highlights a clear dominance in 'What If' space scenarios and extreme planetary anomalies (e.g., liquid diamond planets, dark planets, and unusual planetary physics). Videos leveraging hypothetical 'fall into' or extreme existential cosmic framing achieve significantly higher views-per-day, as well as superior likes-per-view compared to standard psychological facts or traditional biology snippets. Recent uploads from late September and early October (such as Venus's day-year paradox and liquid diamond planet hypotheticals) dramatically outperform older generic animal facts.

winning_patterns.evidence: Videos like 'What If You Fell Into a Liquid Diamond Planet?' (IYuce8vaU3Y) and 'What If You Fell Into the Darkest Planet?' (YlDuGu1vzAg) generated over 800 to 1,000+ views rapidly with high like-to-view ratios.
winning_patterns.action: Double down on cinematic, immersive space-exploration hypotheticals that place the viewer directly into extreme cosmic environments.

winning_patterns.evidence: 'The Planet Darker Than Coal: TrES-2b' (v1rrcZLdp4U) and 'Venus Has a Day Longer Than Its Year' (A9Qa-RmuOr0) pulled over 900 to 1,000 views with strong engagement.
winning_patterns.action: Continue sourcing bizarre, counterintuitive physics and extreme exoplanet weather facts with high visual shock value.

weak_patterns.evidence: Topics like 'Your Brain Can Create Fake Memories' (2fqaGqfsR4A, r43-7nSn8SQ) and 'Your Brain Is Hiding This From You' stalled heavily below 50 views and zero meaningful engagement.
weak_patterns.action: Deprioritize abstract internal psychology facts unless they feature an extreme, counter-intuitive visual or physiological hook.

weak_patterns.evidence: Simple animal facts like 'Octopuses Have THREE Hearts' posted weeks ago failed to scale past initial baseline pushes compared to space content.
weak_patterns.action: Shift animal and nature content strictly toward cinematic survival or extreme evolutionary adaptations rather than simple trivia.
